lines.text: Priya ran back to the nurse station.
Every call light on the ward was blinking now. All at once.
On the security monitor, a tall figure was walking from bed to bed.
Stopping beside each one. Like a nurse, doing her rounds.
Nurse. It's standing by your desk now.
Priya closed her eyes, and didn't move until sunrise.
She quit the next morning. But on ward four, bed seven still calls for a nurse. Every night, at four twelve.
